name: BUY THE FUTURE
description:
BTF — BUY THE FUTURE.

BUY THE FUTURE. BUILD THE NEXT WORLD.

BTF is more than a token. It represents a vision of a new digital future.

We believe the future is not something we wait for — it is something we build together.

Starting with a community-driven digital asset, BTF aims to grow into a broader ecosystem through technology, innovation, and global participation.

Our ambition is to build beyond a token: toward a connected digital economy, an independent network, and ultimately a new generation of blockchain infrastructure.

One Vision. One Community. One Future.

BTF — BUY THE FUTURE.
